EmailChangeNoticeRequest.description: The notice of an e-mail change, sent to the old address every time an Administrator or the Owner changes an account's e-mail. It names the new address and who changed it, and carries no link.

changedByName.description: Who changed the address, as one string in the nominative: a single line with no e-mail address or link.

email.description: The old address, the recipient; must be on the vednemesicnik.cz domain.

newEmail.description: The new address the notice names; must be on the vednemesicnik.cz domain.

Envelope.description: How a request travels. `payload` is a notice request serialised to a string, and it is signed as that exact string — never re-serialised, so the signature does not depend on JSON key order agreeing between the two ends. OWN_SECRET is the signing key and never leaves either end.

payload.description: JSON of a notice request (InvitationRequest or EmailChangeNoticeRequest).

timestamp.description: Unix seconds. Inside the signature, so it cannot be adjusted.

InvitationRequest.description: The invitation of a new user: the ordinary sign-in link, sent with the invitation text, which names who sent it.

email.description: Recipient address; must be on the vednemesicnik.cz domain.

inviterName.description: Who sends the invitation, as one string in the nominative: a single line with no e-mail address or link.

link.description: The sign-in verify URL. Must be an https link on the configured origin whose path is the verify route (/administration/sign-in/magic-link/verify).

mailerError.description: Present only when error is "mailer_send_failed": the underlying reason the delegated send failed.

description: Contract for the Vedneměsíčník users-notice web app: notices to a user of the administration about their account. POST a signed Envelope whose payload is one notice — an InvitationRequest or an EmailChangeNoticeRequest; the response is a UsersNoticeResponse. The send is delegated to the Mailer, whose reason is surfaced in mailerError when error is "mailer_send_failed".
title: UsersNotice
